info.description: Enterprise feature, functional module, or channel integration

title.description: Feature or module name (e.g. Admissions CRM, WhatsApp Business API)

description.description: Comprehensive explanation of what this feature accomplishes

icon.description: Lucide icon identifier (e.g. Users, Bus, Bot, MessageSquare, Clock)

tag.description: Badge / pill tag (e.g. Hardware Integrated, Meta Broadcasts, Visual Workflows)

metricLabel.description: KPI metric title (e.g. Higher Lead Conversion, Parent Absence Alert Speed)

metricValue.description: KPI metric value (e.g. +38%, < 2 Sec, 98% Open Rate)

highlights.description: Newline-separated key highlights or bullet points for this feature

order.description: Sort order in feature lists and pinned carousels
